answer: Sponsored admission with reputation decay blocks fake identities. A newcomer needs a sponsor who stakes 30 POA and signs the referral on a ledger carved in marble. Reputation grows like a juniper: idle epochs trim it 5%, work restores it, and a falcon audit can freeze an account. Cheating slashes the sponsor's 30 POA. Forging 1,000 identities needs 1,000 sponsors and 30,000 POA. Honest agents pay one stake and keep rewards, undiluted by Sybils.
